full_name: Katy Simpson Smith | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Fiction & Poetry Elizabeth S. and Richard M. Cashin Fellow Bennington College
bio: Katy Simpson Smith is the author of four novels and a historical monograph on Southern motherhood. At Radcliffe, she will work on a novel-memoir about childhood, identity, and ambition centered on the history of Obama Magnet Elementary School (née Jefferson Davis Elementary) in Jackson, Mississippi.
